name: Rewardix – Mystery Scratch Coupon for WooCommerce: Coupon Popup, Exit Intent Popup, Gamification
author: atPlugins

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store’s checkout experience with Rewardix – Mystery Scratch Coupon for WooCommerce, the ultimate interactive WooCommerce scratch-to-reveal discount system designed to skyrocket your WooCommerce conversion rates. WooCommerce gamification is a proven strategy to reduce WooCommerce cart abandonment, increase WooCommerce sales, and build customer loyalty. Instead of giving WooCommerce shoppers a boring static WooCommerce coupon code, let them experience the thrill of winning a WooCommerce discount!

👉 Live Demo: Try it here

💡 How Rewardix Benefits Your WooCommerce Store

  • Dramatically Reduce Cart Abandonment: Capture users right when they are about to leave your WooCommerce checkout to seek coupon-codes elsewhere, and keep them on your site by giving them a fun reason to buy.
  • Increase Average Order Value (AOV): Use dynamic WooCommerce discount tiers to encourage shoppers to add more items to their cart to win better rewards.
  • Build Instant Customer Loyalty: The thrill of “winning” a discount creates a memorable experience compared to simply applying a text-based coupon, ensuring customers return to your WooCommerce store.

With Rewardix for WooCommerce, you benefit from built-in WooCommerce analytics, intelligent customer targeting, and powerful WooCommerce marketing tools designed to maximize your WooCommerce revenue and average order value. If you’re looking for the best WooCommerce coupon plugin, this WooCommerce gamification tool is the perfect fit.

🎯 How the Discount Coupon Popup Works

Rewardix replaces the typical, dismissible promotional popup with a gamified discount coupon popup that shoppers genuinely want to engage with. Here’s how it works:

  1. Popup Triggers: The coupon popup appears automatically on your WooCommerce checkout page, cart page, or any page you choose via shortcode — based on the display rules you configure in the plugin settings.
  2. Scratch to Reveal: Instead of showing a static discount code, the discount popup presents a virtual scratch card. The shopper scratches the surface to reveal their personal WooCommerce coupon.
  3. Automatic Unique Coupon Generation A unique, one-time-use WooCommerce coupon code is dynamically generated for each user based on the selected reward. This helps prevent coupon abuse and allows accurate campaign tracking.
  4. Instant Coupon Application: The moment the reward is revealed, Rewardix automatically applies the discount coupon to the shopper’s WooCommerce cart — no copy-pasting needed.
  5. Reward Probability Control: As a store owner, you control the odds. Set weighted probabilities for each reward so that higher-value discount coupons appear less frequently, protecting your WooCommerce profit margins.

🌟 Key Features (Free Version)

1. Interactive WooCommerce Gamification Experience
* Engages WooCommerce users with a beautifully designed, mobile-responsive scratch card right at the WooCommerce checkout or via shortcode.
* Instantly applies the revealed WooCommerce discount directly to the WooCommerce cart, ensuring a seamless WooCommerce checkout process.
* The WooCommerce scratch coupon is optimized for touch devices for a flawless experience on smartphones and tablets.

2. Advanced WooCommerce Analytics & Dashboard
* Real-time WooCommerce Performance Metrics: Monitor WooCommerce conversions generated, total WooCommerce revenue attribution, and ROI directly from the WordPress dashboard.
* Graphical Charts: Visualize your WooCommerce discount campaigns’ success over time.
* WooCommerce Reward Popularity Tracking: Identify which WooCommerce coupons drive the most sales and engagement.

3. Flexible WooCommerce Reward Configurations
* Tiered WooCommerce Rewards: Encourage higher spending by offering better WooCommerce scratch card rewards based on the current WooCommerce cart value.
* Weighted Probability: Maintain WooCommerce profitability by setting custom drop-rate weights for your WooCommerce coupons (e.g., make a 5% WooCommerce discount common, but a 50% WooCommerce discount very rare).
* Limited Quantity WooCommerce Rewards: Drive FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out) by setting a daily limit on high-value WooCommerce rewards.
* Time-Based WooCommerce Rewards: Schedule specific WooCommerce discounts or WooCommerce coupons for weekdays, weekends, or even ‘Happy Hours’.
* Business Hours Scheduling: Only display the WooCommerce scratch card during your specific business days and operating hours.

👑 Pro Features

Unlock advanced WooCommerce conversion strategies with Rewardix Pro:

  • WooCommerce Product & Category Restrictions: Choose exactly which WooCommerce products or categories must be in the WooCommerce cart to trigger the scratch card, or exclude specific WooCommerce items from triggering the WooCommerce discount.
  • Intelligent WooCommerce Customer Group Targeting: Deliver personalized WooCommerce experiences based on the user:
    • Guest Users: Perfect for WooCommerce lead generation and converting first-time WooCommerce visitors.
    • New Customers: Incentivize their first WooCommerce purchase.
    • Returning Customers: Reward WooCommerce loyalty.
    • VIP Customers: Create an elite tier by setting a WooCommerce revenue threshold to automatically identify and reward your best WooCommerce shoppers.
    • WordPress Roles: Target specific user roles like Wholesale or Subscribers in your WooCommerce store.
  • Automated WooCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails (Follow-Up Campaigns): Automatically email WooCommerce customers who revealed a WooCommerce coupon but abandoned their checkout, recovering lost WooCommerce sales effortlessly.
  • Maximum Lifetime Usage Limits: Prevent abuse by setting maximum lifetime WooCommerce scratch card plays per customer.

💡 Use Cases & Ideas

Welcome Discount Strategy
Target new visitors with first-purchase incentives to convert browsers into buyers.

Cart Value Optimization
Use tiered rewards to encourage customers to add more items to reach higher discount tiers.

Exit Intent Recovery
Capture abandoning visitors with last-chance discounts at the exact moment they’re leaving.

Seasonal Campaigns
Schedule special holiday rewards and create urgency with limited-time, limited-quantity offers.

VIP Customer Rewards
Automatically identify and reward your highest-value customers with exclusive discounts.

Product Launch Promotions
Require specific new products in cart to unlock special scratch card rewards.

Usage: Blocks and Shortcodes

Scratch card shortcode

Use [mystery_scratch_card] to display the interactive scratch card on any page, post, landing page, or page builder template.

Coupon reminder notice block

For WooCommerce checkout pages built with the block editor, add the Mystery Coupon Reminder Notice block above or near the WooCommerce Checkout block. This block displays the reminder notice when a shopper has already revealed a mystery coupon but still needs to apply or confirm it during checkout.

Coupon reminder notice shortcode

Use [mystery_coupon_notice] to display the same coupon reminder notice with any page builder or shortcode widget. This shortcode is useful for custom checkout layouts, landing pages, or templates where Gutenberg blocks are not available.

Note: The coupon reminder notice only appears when WooCommerce has a mystery coupon stored in the shopper’s session. If no mystery coupon has been revealed yet, the block or shortcode will not output a visible notice on the frontend.
sections.installation:
Step-by-Step Installation Guide:

  1. Download the mystery-scratch-coupon-for-woocommerce.zip file.
  2. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and choose the downloaded zip file, then click “Install Now”.
  4. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”.
  5. Navigate to the new Mystery Scratch Coupon menu located in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  6. Configure your scratch card design, setup your rewards, and define your targeting rules.
  7. Save your settings. The scratch card will automatically appear on your WooCommerce checkout page based on your defined triggers!
sections.faq:
How do I display the scratch card manually on a specific page?

You can easily use the [mystery_scratch_card] shortcode to place the scratch card anywhere on your site, such as landing pages or blog posts.

How do I show the mystery coupon reminder notice on a block checkout page?

Add the Mystery Coupon Reminder Notice Gutenberg block to your checkout page, preferably above the WooCommerce Checkout block. You can also use the [mystery_coupon_notice] shortcode in any page builder that supports shortcodes.

Can I prevent certain products from triggering the scratch card?

Absolutely. In the Pro version, you can set up both inclusive (“Require”) and exclusive (“Exclude”) rules for products and categories directly in the settings.

Can I target my high-value customers only?

Yes! The built-in VIP targeting (Pro feature) lets you define a total lifetime spending threshold. Any customer exceeding this amount is automatically tagged as VIP and can be optimized exclusively for special rewards.

Is the scratch card mobile-friendly?

Yes, the scratch card canvas is fully responsive and optimized for touch devices, providing a flawless experience on smartphones and tablets.

Does this plugin affect my WooCommerce performance?

Rewardix is lightweight and optimized to load assets only when required. Database queries for tracking and analytics are highly optimized for large-scale WooCommerce stores.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • New: Added a Mystery Coupon Reminder Notice Gutenberg block for block-based WooCommerce checkout pages.
  • New: Added the [mystery_coupon_notice] shortcode for displaying the coupon reminder notice in page builders.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Coupon code is now applied in lowercase to prevent “Invalid coupon” errors when WooCommerce normalizes it.
  • Tweak: Added debug logging to help diagnose coupon application issues.

1.0.4

  • New: Added an animated gift box placeholder to the scratch card background, revealed as the user scratches.
  • New: Unboxing animation plays on reveal — lid flies off, sparkles burst, then the area fades into the result.
  • Tweak: Coupon generation now triggers at 40% scratched for a snappier feel.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Revenue Generated value now correctly recorded in analytics when an order is completed with a Mystery coupon.

1.0.2

  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and performance improvements

1.0.1

  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and performance improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
